verdict.rationale: The only direct SDK evidence is a single first-party mention that API keys work with the 'Core JavaScript SDK' alongside the REST API and Gradient CLI. The documented REST API and official pspace CLI give further programmatic options, but the pack has no dedicated SDK documentation, no multi-language coverage and no published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404). Missing for 10: dedicated SDK docs or reference, Python or other language SDKs, OpenAPI spec for generating clients, independent or hands-on confirmation that the SDK is current and usable.
